title: Eiríkr Åsheim: Uxn: Permacomputing & Roguelikes
speaker: Eiríkr Åsheim
description: Will your favorite roguelikes still be playable in 20 years? How about 50? The Uxn/Varvara ecosystem is a radically simple, portable, and personal approach to computing. Learn how to produce games that fit in 64-kilobyte ROMs and which run on 25-year-old hardware as easily as on modern computers or web browsers. Embrace limits to fuel your creativity!
